blocks.text: Nordel homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Nordel, September 2026. Detached houses: 56 listed at month end and 6 sold in September, a sales ratio of 11% (a buyers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 12 listed at month end and 2 sold in September, a sales ratio of 17% (a balanced market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 37 sold over 4 months against an average of 58.8 listed, about 6.4 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 12 sold. Condos and townhomes: 9 sold over 4 months against an average of 12.2 listed, about 5.4 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 4 sold.

faq.q: What is the Nordel Social Heart?
faq.a: It is the ND12 development permit area in Delta's 2024 OCP, centred on 84 Avenue and 112 Street, whose stated purpose is to revitalize Nordel as the community focus for North Delta; the library, recreation centre and community park all sit in that core.

faq.q: Which schools serve a Nordel address?
faq.a: It depends on the address. For the sample address 11415 84 Avenue, the SD37 locator result is Richardson Elementary (K–7) and North Delta Secondary (8–12); SD37 has no middle-school tier, and catchments are address-based.
Route 312 on 112 Street and route 391 on 116 Street, both between Scottsdale Exchange and Scott Road Station (Expo Line), with stops at Nordel Way.

faq.q: Can a Nordel house lot add a suite or garden suite?
faq.a: Delta's SSMUH regulations allow secondary suites, coach houses and garden suites in combination with single detached and duplex dwellings where the zoning applies.
The Delta Nature Reserve, the publicly accessible part of Burns Bog, accessed at 10388 Nordel Court; Burns Bog is protected as an Ecological Conservancy Area.
